title: Issue Router Testing
description: Validate that the Issue Router can dispatch actual Kanbus issues from the shared kbs board, starting with clearly marked, disposable test tasks and progressing toward safe real work. Use separate containers as independent router machines, each with its own checkout and no shared UDS socket, connected to the same Git remote, MQTT broker, and Mutex API. First verify hard mutual exclusion so exactly one worker starts an opted-in test issue and the loser makes no lifecycle transition. Then validate lease expiry/takeover and, only with a harmless test task, document soft-provider duplicate behavior. Capture worker logs, claim IDs, issue comments/status, and Git/router-state evidence. Never route unrelated production issues during these tests. Leave successful test issues in the configured Review stage for visible human review; preserve failed issues and diagnostic evidence for inspection rather than closing issues.

comments.text: The single-worker production dispatch test task completed and its exact requested comment was reviewed. Multi-router hard-lease validation remains separately tracked for the next stage.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Complete: single-worker dispatch passed earlier; multi-router hard exclusion, expiry/takeover and soft-duplicate behavior are now verified live. Verified live on 2026-09-23 with tools/issue_router_container_integration_harness.py (Docker workers on independent checkouts, no shared UDS, the production Mutex API and MQTT broker, a deterministic fake Codex agent so no model key is needed; disposable test tasks under the fixed epic kbs-d3973c07). hard-race: exactly one of the Python and Rust workers started the task, the other got the documented 'package already claimed' response and made no transition, and the winner's task reached Review with the router comment (test issue kbs-ed894564). soft-duplicate (Mutex disabled, git coordination): passed, one worker started (kbs-5e94f099). expiry-takeover: the lease holder was killed, its 30s lease expired, and a second worker took over and completed the task (kbs-6c66c6a6). PRs: #354 fake-agent mode, #355 scenarios, #357 config and coordination fixes, #358, #362 loser/full-id/start-event/TTL fixes, #356 Rust forge-less run parity. Live findings filed: kbs-f7c9a9 (router event rescan cost), kbs-7d2e34 (long-lived Mutex tokens). Successful test tasks are left in Review and failed ones preserved for inspection.

right_now_summary: Single-worker dispatch passed; multi-router lease testing is next, while one smoke test awaits its report.
